nodes.name: DependencyInjection.cs
nodes.summary: Composition-root extension method wiring the EF Core DbContext (Postgres/SQLite) and all repository/Excel-file implementations into the DI container.

nodes.name: DependencyInjection
nodes.summary: Static class hosting the AddInfrastructure extension method used by the API startup to register infrastructure services.

nodes.name: AddInfrastructure
nodes.summary: Reads the configured connection string and provider name to configure EF Core with Npgsql or Sqlite, then registers repository and Excel-file services with the DI container.

nodes.name: ExcelManagement.Infrastructure.csproj
nodes.summary: Project file for the Infrastructure layer, referencing EF Core, Npgsql, Sqlite, and ClosedXML packages used by persistence and Excel I/O code.

nodes.name: AppDbContext.cs
nodes.summary: EF Core DbContext exposing Employees, Departments, Users, AuditLogs, and RefreshTokens sets, with entity configuration and automatic audit-log capture on every SaveChanges call.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides SaveChanges/SaveChangesAsync to wrap writes in a transaction and diff ChangeTracker entries into AuditLog rows via reflection-free JSON serialization of changed property values.

nodes.name: AppDbContext
nodes.summary: Central EF Core context configuring all entity mappings and intercepting save operations to persist an audit trail alongside normal writes.

nodes.name: OnModelCreating
nodes.summary: Configures column constraints, unique indexes, and foreign-key relationships for Employee, Department, User, AuditLog, and RefreshToken entities.

nodes.name: SaveChangesAsync
nodes.summary: Captures pending audit entries, wraps the save in a transaction, persists the primary changes, writes the resulting audit logs, then commits.

nodes.name: SaveChanges
nodes.summary: Synchronous counterpart to SaveChangesAsync that captures audit entries, persists changes inside a transaction, and writes the audit log rows.

nodes.name: CaptureAuditEntries
nodes.summary: Walks the ChangeTracker's added/modified/deleted entries and builds pending audit records with the entity name, id, action, and changed-property JSON.

nodes.name: BuildChangesJson
nodes.summary: Serializes the set of changed property values for a tracked entity entry into a JSON string stored on the audit log row.

nodes.name: AuditLogRepository.cs
nodes.summary: EF Core-backed repository that queries and filters audit log entries for the audit log listing feature.

nodes.name: AuditLogRepository
nodes.summary: Repository implementation exposing a single filtered, paged-free query method over the AuditLogs table.

nodes.name: GetAsync
nodes.summary: Builds a filtered, ordered query over AuditLogs by entity name, action, and date range, then projects results into AuditLogDto records.

nodes.name: DepartmentRepository.cs
nodes.summary: EF Core-backed repository providing listing, existence checks, name-uniqueness checks, creation, and update operations for departments.

nodes.name: DepartmentRepository
nodes.summary: Repository implementing department listing, validation, and mutation operations against AppDbContext.

nodes.name: GetAllAsync
nodes.summary: Returns departments ordered by name, optionally excluding inactive ones, projected to DepartmentDto.

nodes.name: UpdateAsync
nodes.summary: Looks up a department by id and updates its name and active flag, persisting the change and returning the updated DTO.

nodes.name: EmployeeExcelFile.cs
nodes.summary: ClosedXML-based implementation of IEmployeeExcelFile that writes employee lists to a workbook and parses uploaded workbooks back into import rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses header-name-to-column-index mapping so the importer tolerates reordered columns in uploaded spreadsheets.

nodes.name: EmployeeExcelFile
nodes.summary: Concrete Excel reader/writer for employee data built on the ClosedXML (XLWorkbook) library.

nodes.name: WriteWorkbook
nodes.summary: Builds an XLWorkbook with a header row and one row per employee, returning the serialized bytes for download.

nodes.name: ReadRows
nodes.summary: Parses an uploaded Excel stream by matching header names to columns, then reads each non-empty row into an EmployeeImportRow.

nodes.name: EmployeeRepository.cs
nodes.summary: EF Core-backed repository implementing paged/filtered listing, CRUD, and bulk import for employees, including query filter construction and date parsing.

nodes.name: EmployeeRepository
nodes.summary: Primary employee data-access implementation, combining dynamic filtering, paging, and Excel-import persistence against AppDbContext.

nodes.name: GetPagedAsync
nodes.summary: Clamps page/pageSize, runs a count and a skip/take query against the filtered projection, and returns a PagedResult of employee list items.

nodes.name: ProjectListItems
nodes.summary: Applies the filtered query and orders/projects rows into EmployeeListItemDto shapes for listing.

nodes.name: BuildFilteredQuery
nodes.summary: Composes a queryable over Employees by conditionally applying name, department, active-state, and join-date-range filters from the request.

nodes.name: TryParseJoinDate
nodes.summary: Attempts to parse a join-date filter string using the employee validator's expected date format.

nodes.name: CreateAsync
nodes.summary: Constructs a new Employee entity from the upsert request, saves it, and returns the resulting detail DTO.

nodes.name: UpdateAsync
nodes.summary: Loads an existing employee by id, applies the upsert request's field values, and persists the update.

nodes.name: DeleteAsync
nodes.summary: Finds an employee by id and removes it from the database, returning whether the deletion occurred.

nodes.name: ImportAsync
nodes.summary: Maps a batch of upsert requests from an Excel import into Employee entities with a shared timestamp and bulk-saves them.

nodes.name: 20260913183412_AddUsers.cs
nodes.summary: EF Core migration adding the Users table with a unique index on username, supporting the new authentication feature.

nodes.name: Up
nodes.summary: Creates the Users table with Id, Username, PasswordHash, and Role columns plus a unique index on Username.
